# vcharacter-prime

> Provably fair character creation on the Verus blockchain. RPG
> characters whose stats are determined by commit-reveal randomness
> across a client seed and a future Verus block hash, owned by the
> player's VerusID, with a verifiably replayable single-shot
> adventure called The Primordial Trial.

vcharacter-prime is a web app at https://prime.vcharacter.xyz. The
character is signed once into the player's VerusID under a
ContentMultiMap entry and can be read by any app that knows the
identity name. Stats are 4d6 per ability score, with a d6 element,
d12 spirit animal, and d2 sex.

## Docs

- [Verus primer](https://prime.vcharacter.xyz/verus-primer): the
  three Verus primitives the app is built on — Proof of Power,
  VerusID, and ContentMultiMap with VDXF keys.
- [How it works](https://prime.vcharacter.xyz/how-it-works): how
  characters are created, what data lives on-chain, and how anyone
  can verify the rolls.
- [Game guide](https://prime.vcharacter.xyz/game-guide): character
  stats, traits, and how they shape The Primordial Trial.

## Optional

- [Full docs](https://prime.vcharacter.xyz/llms-full.txt): all three
  doc pages concatenated as a single text file.
